history.summary: A compact 657 sqft 99-year leasehold 2BR in D19 Serangoon at $2207 PSF / $1.45M, 420m from Serangoon MRT interchange (NEL/Circle Line + NEX mall). Strong location and a solid 128-txn URA series (~4.3% CAGR), but the asking is ~5% ABOVE the $2095 project median.
history.rating_rationale: Excellent location — 420m to Serangoon interchange and NEX mall, young 2021 build, 128-txn URA series showing a healthy ~4.3% CAGR. Offsetting that, the asking $2207 PSF is ~5% above the $2095 median, the unit is a compact 657 sqft 2BR, 99-yr leasehold caps tenure value, and $2207 PSF is a high absolute number for D19 OCR. Good fundamentals neutralized by an above-median asking price — a fair-value hold, not a bargain.
red_flags: Asking ~5% above project URA median ($2207 vs $2095)
$2207 PSF is high for D19 OCR, leaning on the interchange premium
catalysts: 420m to NE12 Serangoon interchange (NEL + Circle Line) and NEX mall
